entities.summary: Sayed Muhammad Yusuf, later known as Shahzada Muhammad Yusuf was a field hockey player who represented two countries namely India and Afghanistan in international hockey. In the 1928 Summer Olympics held at Amsterdam, he had participated as S M Yusuf.
